pages.text: Boss materials are unique drops used in waystone construction, Class Altar crafting, $(t4)T4$() recipes, and mythic infusion. Each boss's material has specific uses.$(br2)$(bold)T2:$() Naga Scale (armor), Lich Soul (necromantic), Hydra Fang (melee enhancement), Ur-Ghast Tear (aerial items).$(br2)$(bold)T3:$() Harbinger Eye, Ignis Core, Nether Soul Fragment, Gaia Spirit Fragment (Mahou Tsukai initiation).$(br2)$(bold)T4:$() Dragon Heart (mythic infusion base), Dragon Scale (armor), Void Essence (Void Summoner builds), Wither Bone.
